'''Tyler Franks''' was a finalist at the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]. Franks qualified through Endor Seattle from Bozeman, Montana.<ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Franks won the [[1997 Edmonton Open]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"Age, 20."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/franks.html Tyler Franks], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427182458/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/franks.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"Born and currently reside in Bozeman, Montana."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm a Junior in English Education at Montana State University."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My hobbies, (other than Star Wars CCG) are frisbee golf, playing guitar and collecting recordings of live musical performances."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I've played Star Wars CCG since the fall of '96."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Here are a few favorites: Star Wars personae, Boba Fett: musicians, Phish; artist, Salvador Dali; and late night TV show, Conan O'Brien."<ref name="dec97bio" />
